title: Football-crowd-chanting-cheering-goal-mouth-action-from-freekick-then-cornerkick.wav by paulw2k
author: paulw2k
sourceDescription: This is an extract of a sound recording I made at the Brentford vs Swansea match on 12th September 2006, which I used to open the play "There'll always be a Brentford" performed at the Questors Theatre, Ealing, London in November 2006. The play commemorates 100 years of Brentford FC at its present home Griffin Park.
